title: ArrowYesNo
description: Per-call schema for the decomposed arrow yes/no calls. Asks whether a candidate (from_id, to_id) pair represents a real cause-and-effect arrow in the strategy map. Many of these fire in parallel (one per candidate pair); the assembly layer filters to enables=true and constructs Arrow records. NOTE: hypothesis is declared as ['string', 'null'] because OpenAI structured-output mode rejects JSON Schema `if`/`then`/`else` conditionals, so we cannot express 'hypothesis MUST be a non-null string when enables=true' at the schema level. The prompt instructs the model to set hypothesis to a non-null 20-500 char sentence when enables=true; the Python assembly layer in `_strategy_map_arrows.py` raises a named-pair ValueError if it sees `{enables: true, hypothesis: null}` so the schema-level slip surfaces immediately rather than blowing up later at Pydantic Arrow construction.
